display.purpose: Section and hero headlines, split into masked reveal lines; Archivo 800 at width 112% (100% for the phone hero).

headline.purpose: Ruled-list row titles (clusters, focus areas, principles) and the mobile menu.

body.purpose: Descriptions and answers, max 60-65ch, usually muted.

label.purpose: Uppercase captions, field labels, corner data and small links. Never an eyebrow above a headline.

data.purpose: JetBrains Mono for dates, times, coordinates and counts only.

shadows.name: emblem-float
shadows.purpose: Only under the circular cursor-follow cluster emblem on the blue field.

motion.name: ease-expo
motion.purpose: The system easing for every reveal, hover slide and state transition.

motion.name: ease-wipe
motion.purpose: Full-screen clip-path wipes: preloader exit (1000ms) and mobile menu (700ms).

motion.name: reveal-line
motion.value: transform translateY(125%) -> 0, 1.1s ease-expo, 70ms stagger per line
motion.purpose: Masked line reveal for display headlines.

motion.name: fade-blur
motion.value: opacity 0 / blur(8px) / translateY(24px) -> rest; opacity+filter 1s, transform 1.2s ease-expo; delay var(--d)
motion.purpose: Blur-up entrance for paragraphs, list rows and blocks.

motion.name: clip-reveal
motion.value: clip-path inset(100% 0 0 0) -> inset(0) 1.4s; img scale 1.25 -> 1 over 1.8s ease-expo

motion.name: hero-fade
motion.purpose: Hero corner data, intro, actions after the preloader.

motion.name: preloader
motion.value: counter 000->100 over 1600ms cubic-out, then 1000ms ease-wipe upward
motion.purpose: Once per session; skipped on repeat visits and reduced motion.

motion.name: lenis
motion.purpose: Site-wide smooth scroll and anchor routing; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: rule-grow
motion.value: 1px ACE Blue line scaleX 0 -> 1 or width 0 -> 100%, 700ms ease-expo
motion.purpose: Row hover / focus-list active rule, nav active underline (500ms).

motion.name: cursor-follow
motion.value: lerp 0.16 per frame, tilt clamp +/-14deg from velocity; emblem circle clip 0% -> 50%, 500ms ease-expo
motion.purpose: Cluster emblem following the cursor on the blue field (fine pointers only).

motion.name: live-pulse
motion.purpose: Live dot beside an open event.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disables Lenis, reveals, fades, clip, marquee, pulse and particle animation; content is visible by default without JS.

narrative.overview:
ACE is drawn in two materials and one charge. Ink and bone (ink ground in dark mode, inverted to bone in light) carry everything structural; ACE Blue, derived from the logo's blue and pushed electric, is the charge. It marks the one thing that matters on a line, and once per page it floods an entire section as a full-bleed field. The type does the shouting: Archivo's width axis is stretched to 112% at weight 800 and set at viewport scale, with tight negative tracking and lines that nearly touch. Everything else is quiet: 1px hairlines, square corners, generous section rhythm, and small uppercase sans labels.

The structure is editorial, not app-like. Content sits on a 12-column grid inside a 1600px frame and is organised as ruled lists (rows separated by hairlines) rather than as boxes. Depth comes from inversion and motion, not elevation: an inked panel, a blue field, a masked line rising into place. Motion is expo-out throughout and always degrades to static, fully visible content under reduced motion or without JavaScript.

The system was built against the stock template it replaced: centred gradient headlines, background video, icon cards and team cards. None of those exist here.
keyCharacteristics: Ink and bone, inverted between dark and light mode; ACE Blue as the single accent.
One drenched blue field per page (the clusters section on the landing).
Archivo variable at giant display scale, width axis stretched; JetBrains Mono reserved for data.
1px hairlines and square corners; no cards, no glass, no gradients.
Ruled lists as the primary content structure.
Expo-out motion: masked line reveals, blur-up fades, clip reveals, Lenis smooth scroll.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue floods at most one full-bleed section per page. Everywhere else blue is a mark on a single word, line or control, never a background wash.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: Panels gain emphasis by swapping ink and bone (foreground becomes background), never by adding a tint, a gradient or a shadow.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono sets only machine values: dates, times, coordinates, counts. Labels, captions and UI copy stay in Archivo.

rules.name: The Two-Line Headline Rule
rules.body: Display headlines are short declaratives split into reveal lines ("Show up. / Level up."). The accent, if any, falls on one whole line or word in ACE Blue.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: Containers, controls and panels never cast shadows. If something needs emphasis, invert it or rule it.

dos: Do set structure with 1px hairlines and square corners (0px) on every container and control.
Do keep ACE Blue to one mark per line or control, and flood Signal Blue across at most one full-bleed section per page.
Do set display headlines in Archivo 800 at width 112%, tracking -0.04em, line-height 0.88, split into reveal lines.
Do use JetBrains Mono only for dates, times, coordinates and counts, with tabular figures.
Do present collections as ruled lists with a leading column, a headline column and a trailing arrow.
Do ease everything with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), and keep content visible without JavaScript and under reduced motion.
Do emphasise a panel by inverting ink and bone.
Do crop cluster emblems to full circles; it is the only curve in the system.
donts: Don't use cards, glass, backdrop blur or tinted boxes to group content.
Don't use gradients, including gradient text.
Don't put small uppercase eyebrows above headlines; the label voice is for captions, fields and data only.
Don't set labels or UI copy in mono.
Don't cast shadows from containers, buttons or panels; the emblem float is the only shadow.
Don't use the 0.375rem radius token on new surfaces.
Don't use background video or centred hero stacks.
